title: sdks: unify auth/retries and streaming ergonomics across python/typescript/go; parity fixes & version bumps
author: Alicia Park
description:
Motivation: SDKs (Python, TypeScript, Go) drifted in three areas: auth header handling (token refresh behavior), retry/backoff semantics, and streaming API ergonomics. This caused surprising behavior for users migrating code between languages and made cross-language examples brittle. This PR unifies the canonical behaviors and bumps SDK versions to ship compatibility fixes.

What this PR does (summary):
- Standardizes auth: all SDKs now treat 401/403 as retry-with-refresh when a refresh callback is registered; token refresh is serialized to a single in-flight refresh per process/client instance to avoid thundering-herd.
- Harmonizes retry policy: default policy is now idempotent-aware with a 3-attempt default, exponential backoff with jitter, and unified transient error classification (5xx, 429, and transport errors).
- Streaming ergonomics: consistent streaming iterator patterns and cancelation hooks. Python yields an async generator with a close() method on the response object; TS exposes an async iterable with a cancel() on the controller object; Go exposes a Stream object with Recv() and Close().
- Parity fixes & version bumps: small API surface parity changes (renamed internal helper names, added missing context propagation in Go), updated changelogs and bumped package versions: python 1.12.0, typescript 2.3.1, go 0.9.4.
- Tests & CI: added cross-SDK e2e smoke tests for auth refresh and streaming, updated unit tests for retry/backoff.

Checklist:
- [x] Design doc and Linear task linked below.
- [x] Unit tests updated.
- [x] E2E smoke tests added to CI matrix.
- [x] Release notes drafted.
- [x] Backwards compatibility validated for common usage patterns.

Migration notes for users:
- If you provided a manual retry wrapper expecting different backoff semantics, you may see different timing; recommended: remove custom retry when possible and rely on SDK default policy.
- For streaming: code that previously relied on library-internal iterators should switch to the documented generator/iterable/Stream APIs. Examples in the README have been updated.

Related work: Linear ENG-3402 (auth parity), ENG-3411 (retry policy), ENG-3425 (streaming ergonomics).
